faqPage.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqPage.intro: Here we answer the most common questions about how SharemeChat works, and how sessions and payments operate.

items.a: SharemeChat is a live 1-to-1 video chat platform where you connect with verified models in real time for private conversations inside the platform.

items.q: How does the video chat work?
items.a: Once registered, you start a live session and the system connects you with an available model. If you enjoy the conversation, you can add them to your contacts and talk again later.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. SharemeChat works directly in your browser. You only need a webcam, an internet connection and a modern browser.
Creating an account is free. Private video sessions use prepaid credits; there are no subscriptions.
Sessions are paid with prepaid credits bought through one-time payments inside the platform. No subscriptions and no hidden charges.
Yes. Payments are handled by trusted providers, and sensitive details are managed by secure payment infrastructure.

items.q: Can I stop a session whenever I want?
items.a: Yes. You can end a video session at any moment from the interface.

items.q: What happens if my connection drops?
items.a: If a connection problem occurs, the session stops automatically and only the time it was actually active is counted.

items.q: Do I need to verify my age?
items.a: Yes. SharemeChat is strictly for adults 18+. Every account goes through identity and age verification before you can interact.

items.q: Are the models real and verified?
items.a: Yes. Both clients and models go through identity and age verification before they can interact. Models pass a stricter check (official document + selfie + liveness), so you're talking to real, verified people — not bots.
Yes. If you don't want to interact with someone again, you can block them.
Yes. Reporting tools let you flag abusive or suspicious behaviour. Reports are reviewed to keep the environment safe.
Safety and privacy are a priority. The platform uses moderation systems, monitoring tools and technical safeguards to protect both users and models.
Yes. Each session is a private one-to-one between the two people: it isn't broadcast or opened to third parties. To keep the space safe, the platform relies on automated safety measures.

items.q: Can I work as a model?
Where can I read the rules?
items.a: You can review them in our Community Guidelines and the legal information in our Terms of Service.

modelKyc.title: Identity verification
modelKyc.intro: To complete your sign-up as a model we need to verify your identity and age. The verification uses camera and document: our provider (Didit, EU-certified) reads your ID document and checks it matches your face via a selfie.
modelKyc.whyLegal: This is required by minor-protection and adult-content regulations in the markets we operate in (EU DSA, UK OSA, US Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton). It is not optional.
modelKyc.consentText: I explicitly consent to my ID document and my facial biometric data (image of my face) being processed by Didit (data processor, EU) for the purpose of verifying my identity and age, under Art. 9.2.a GDPR. Data is stored for as long as needed to fulfil applicable legal obligations and then deleted. I may withdraw consent at any time by contacting privacy@sharemechat.com; in that case, I will not be able to complete the model sign-up.

clientKyc.intro: Our provider Didit (EU-certified) estimates your age from your camera. No document upload, no third-party sign-up.
clientKyc.whyLegal: Before you can top up your wallet we need to confirm that you are an adult. No ID document is requested unless the result is borderline. This is required by minor-protection regulations in the markets where we operate (EU DSA Art. 28, UK OSA, US Free Speech Coalition v. Paxton). It is not optional.
clientKyc.consentText: I give my explicit consent for my facial biometric data (an image of my face) to be processed by Didit (data processor, EU) for the sole purpose of estimating my age, under Art. 9.2.a GDPR. The data is stored for 6 months and then automatically deleted. I can withdraw consent at any time by contacting privacidad@sharemechat.com; in that case my account will lose the ability to top up and consume adult content.

masterKyc.title: Identity verification (KYC)
masterKyc.intro: To complete your Master sign-up we need to verify your identity (natural person). The verification is done with camera and document: our provider (Didit, EU certified) reads your ID document and checks it matches your face via a selfie.
masterKyc.whyLegal: This is required by anti-fraud and Know-Your-Customer (KYC) regulation applicable to the Master program operation. Not optional.
masterKyc.consentText: I give my explicit consent for my ID document and my facial biometric data (image of my face) to be processed by Didit (data processor, EU) for the purpose of verifying my identity as Master, pursuant to Art. 9.2.a GDPR. Data is kept for as long as legal obligations require, then deleted. I can withdraw consent at any time by contacting privacidad@sharemechat.com; in that case, Master sign-up cannot be completed.
masterKyc.consentAck: I have read and accept the biometric and identity processing consent.
